name: A.P.C.
why: Parisian minimalism; the Petit Standard raw jean as modern reference.
origin: Jean Touitou, Paris, 1987 — Atelier de Production et de Création; built around one product, the Petit Standard raw jean.
opview: Touitou's position: clothes that age well beat clothes that impress fast.

notes.denim: the Petit Standard — modern raw denim's reference cut
notes.fren: the doctrine of effortlessness — clothes that refuse to try

cities: NYC, LA, SF stores · dept & boutiques
